name: smoke-file-download
description: Hermetic smoke test: open a blank page, generate a small CSV in-browser, and trigger a download. Proves the executor's download routing and the outputs.file_path / outputs.download_files derivation over the live API. No external portal or credentials.

RUN_DATE.description: Date stamp interpolated into the generated CSV filename.

steps.name: Generate a CSV in-browser and trigger a download
steps.value: const blob = new Blob(['col_a,col_b\n1,2\n'], {type: 'text/csv'}); const a = document.createElement('a'); a.href = URL.createObjectURL(blob); a.download = 'smoke_${RUN_DATE}.csv'; document.body.appendChild(a); a.click();

steps.name: Wait for the download to land on disk
